name: ansi-escape-code
description: Effortless ANSI styling with nesting support

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @ansi-escape-code/type run build && rimraf dist && rollup -c && cpy npm.md dist --rename=README.md && package-json-minifier
scripts.build:all: pnpm run build && pnpm --recursive --filter './packages/**' --filter '!@ansi-escape-code/type' run build
scripts.publish: pnpm run build && cd dist && pnpm publish
scripts.test: pnpm run build:all && tsc --project tests/tsconfig.json && node --test tests/*.test.cjs
